title: McpEndpoint
description: A deployed AAP MCP endpoint. The URL may use a platform host but must be linked from the dealer-controlled discovery domain. Query strings, fragments and embedded credentials are not endpoint identity.

protocol_versions.description: Every actually supported MCP revision. AAP 3.1 requires both the current baseline and the initialization-based compatibility revision.

public_read.description: True when the advertised read skills can be called without customer sign-in or an access token. Does not waive consent on lead submission or authorize private data access.
